A '''fft knife''' was a ceremonial knife used by the [[Ssi-ruu]]k to cut open [[fft]]. It was approximately 20 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long with three prongs that ended in a serrated blade. They were very durable and required little maintenance. A large amount were captured from the [[Sibwarra|''Shriwirr'']] and kept as trophies by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] troops.<ref name="TBS" />
